label: Core alpha (ridge challenger)
blurb: A challenger to the IC weights: each January the family scores are regressed, by ridge regression on every month known by then, on the next month's ranked returns. It allows for the families' correlation and may short one. It replaces the baseline only if it wins in the early years, the later years and the holdout.
literature: Hoerl and Kennard (1970); the families as features, lambda fixed at one
